attestation.statement: I attest that each target is a trusted reference of the same scene, spatially aligned to its input and expressed in the same 14-bit count domain (e.g. a long-exposure/multi-frame average from a stationary camera that I verified). It is not an adjacent noisy frame, a blurred frame or a model prediction.

target.description: how this reference was produced and verified

_notes: Recordings are grouped by recording_id; a recording (or any file hash) may appear in ONE split only.
Use a 'test' split only for a final, untouched evaluation; it is stored separately and gated.
Keys beginning with _ are ignored comments.
